panels.title: Daily Energy by Device
panels.description: Day-over-day difference of the daily MAX of the pod-collapsed energy total. Plain delta()/increase() over raw series explodes to +/-200 kWh/day because the exporter's shelly_*_energy series intermittently reset and are exposed by multiple short-lived pods (each restart creates a new series that get extrapolated). Collapsing pods with max by(...) and using max_over_time removes both artifacts. Falls back to first/last within the window for devices whose series do not reach back a full day (e.g. newly added multi-channel devices), so they are not dropped.

targets.expr: sum by (device_name, name) (clamp_min((max_over_time((max by (device_mac,switch_id,name) (shelly_switch_energy{device_mac=~"$device"}))[$__range:5m]) - max_over_time((max by (device_mac,switch_id,name) (shelly_switch_energy{device_mac=~"$device"}))[$__range:5m] offset $__range)) or (last_over_time((max by (device_mac,switch_id,name) (shelly_switch_energy{device_mac=~"$device"}))[$__range:5m]) - first_over_time((max by (device_mac,switch_id,name) (shelly_switch_energy{device_mac=~"$device"}))[$__range:5m])) or (max_over_time((max by (device_mac,cover_id,name) (shelly_cover_energy{device_mac=~"$device"}))[$__range:5m]) - max_over_time((max by (device_mac,cover_id,name) (shelly_cover_energy{device_mac=~"$device"}))[$__range:5m] offset $__range)) or (last_over_time((max by (device_mac,cover_id,name) (shelly_cover_energy{device_mac=~"$device"}))[$__range:5m]) - first_over_time((max by (device_mac,cover_id,name) (shelly_cover_energy{device_mac=~"$device"}))[$__range:5m])), 0) * on(device_mac) group_left(device_name) shelly_device_info)
